blocks.x: Applying Agentic AI & Hyperautomation in Public Sector & Government: the context that decides the design, the weekly cadence, the towers involved, and committed outcomes per gate.

In Public Sector & Government, agentic ai & hyperautomation turns knowledge work into orchestrated autonomy. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: agentic process automation, digital workforce & multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence systems — delivered on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Web, phone and counter experiences diverge; back-office handoffs lose context and create rework loops.
Benefits, tax, health and licensing systems never joined; citizens re-submit the same facts to every agency. Fraud and error hide in the seams.
Permits, claims and case files are paper-shaped; processing times measured in months erode trust and increase cost per case.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

Delivery composes 7 services from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower — Agentic Process Automation, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Decision Intelligence Systems, Intelligent Document Processing as the usual core — sequenced through the Dataq Method, with GDPR / national privacy law obligations shaping the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.
Decision paths that run in milliseconds, with policy checks and full logging.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.
Evidence gathered across registries for benefit/licensing decisions with officer approval (backlog reduction at stable staff)
Cross-agency analytics scoring anomalies with investigator case packs (capture up at stable load)
First-contact resolution up sharply with grounded assistants

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: GDPR / national privacy law and Accessibility (Section 508 / EN 301 549 / WCAG). Digital services must meet accessibility mandates. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. The first two weeks lock the baseline: your team and ours measure the current metric together and sign it. Weeks 3–8 carry the pilot on bounded scope — a single decision path, workflow, plant or portfolio — and a control owner on your side owns the evidence. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement, and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Missing a gate produces a documented decision to stop or redirect — never a silent extension.
